name: Step Five: Life Events
notes:
A character's life is made up of a mosaic of their experiences, emotions, and relationships, which together inform a character's worldview, values, and self-image. Some of the events that a character has experienced may be more pivotal than others, and these moments in a character's life are defined in this stage of the lifepath.

Before choosing their life events, you should decide how old your character is. Is your character still young and relatively inexperienced with much of their life still ahead; are they mature and well into adulthood; or are they older, with decades of experience under their belt, with potentially even children of their own? This decision will help you decide what life events are appropriate to choose from when making your character.

Each character should have two life events. If you want your character to have more than two, you may (with Gamemaster's approval), as long as you do not exceed the number of Focuses or Attribute bonuses that are gained at this stage. When picking your character's life events, you may choose from the list below or roll on the table to have them randomly assigned.

Each life event grants your character a Focus (select one that relates to skills your character learned or used during this life event) and +1 to an Attribute (reflecting the lasting impact that experience had on your character as a person) - once for each of the two Life Events chosen.

Because each character's life and circumstances are unique, you may also choose to combine life events or come up with a new and unique life event for your character that is not listed below, so long as they still gain one relevant Focus and a +1 to an Attribute.

options.name: Ran away from home
options.description: Your character—either as a child or an adult—ran away from home, forsaking their family name and potentially their titles.

options.name: Death of a loved one
options.description: Your character, at some point in their life, has lost a loved one.

options.name: Serious injury
options.description: Your character was seriously hurt and needed to spend a considerable amount of time recovering.

options.name: Religious conversion
options.description: Your character has converted to a new faith.

options.name: Disowned
options.description: Your character was disowned by their family, and forced to live without their support or wealth.

options.name: Committed a crime
options.description: Your character has committed a crime at one point in their life and reaped the consequences of it, often viewed with suspicion if not outright distrust.

options.name: Lucky break
options.description: Your character happened to be in the right place at the right time, and made an impactful choice that earned them a positive reputation and potentially a real reward, such as being knighted after rescuing a queen from a bandit attack.

options.name: Won a decisive battle
options.description: Your character took charge of their forces and struck a decisive blow, winning a battle that changed the tide of a conflict, if not winning it altogether.

options.name: Ascended a throne
options.description: Your character gained a noble title, whether inherited from a deceased relative or granted as a reward by a monarch.

options.name: Married
options.description: Your character got married, whether in an arranged marriage or one of their own choosing.

options.name: Took religious orders
options.description: Your character swore an oath to a religious order, taking orders as a monk or a nun and devoting themself wholly to their faith.

options.name: Unknown origins
options.description: Your character doesn't know their birth family or where they came from, and was raised by someone else.

options.name: Survived an assassination attempt
options.description: Someone tried to kill your character, but they narrowly escaped death.

options.name: Joined a crew
options.description: Your character has joined a band or company of people, maybe a mercenary company or a guild of artisans or even a secret society.

options.name: Made a powerful enemy
options.description: Your character, whether through action or circumstance, has made an enemy of someone powerful who is out for your blood.
